fields.System.Title: INV-604 — Flag expired stock as unsellable
fields.System.Description:
Story

As an inventory controller, I want expired stock removed from availability
automatically, so that nobody can allocate or ship something past its date.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a batch whose expiry date has passed, then its stock is excluded from
  • availability without a manual step.
  • - Given stock that expires while reserved, then the reservation is flagged and the order
  • re-allocated.
  • - Given expired stock, then it remains visible, countable, and adjustable — it is
  • excluded from selling, not deleted.
  • - Given expired stock, then it appears on a disposal work list.
  • - Given the expiry boundary, then it is evaluated in the warehouse timezone, not UTC
  • midnight.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | inventory, outbound |
| Tables | stock_balance, batch, reservation |
| Risks | Expired stock shipped; timezone boundary errors ([doc 09 §9.4](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration |
